basis: ID/microcephaly and Coffin-Siris nail/digital abnormalities define the phenotype; nail hypoplasia and clinodactyly 2/2. Delayed puberty alone does not establish common hypogonadism.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: fifth-finger/toe nail hypoplasia in 2/2 is a defining Coffin-Siris feature.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: hypogonadism is optional; delayed puberty in 1/2 does not establish hypogonadotropic hypogonadism in at least 30%.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: digital skeletal abnormalities are characteristic of the Coffin-Siris phenotype; clinodactyly occurs in 2/2.

basis: Microcephaly, cutaneous albinism and digital skeletal defects define the syndrome. Oculocutaneous albinism affects visual development; iris hypopigmentation occurs in 80-99%.

decisions.ocular: involved: defining oculocutaneous albinism affects visual development; ocular pigmentation abnormalities occur in 80-99%; three primary slots are occupied.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: digital phalangeal hypoplasia/aplasia is named and explicitly defining, occurring in 80-99%.

basis: Severe hypothyroidism with characteristic myxedematous skin thickening from dermal glycosaminoglycan deposition; autoimmune causation is not universal.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: characteristic myxedematous skin thickening reflects dermal glycosaminoglycan deposition and forms part of this disease's defining phenotype.

basis: MHC II combined immunodeficiency. Delay/ataxia each 1/3 and brain atrophy 1/1 assessed do not establish direct CNS injury independent of infection; recurrent infections are separate diseases.

decisions.neurologic: none: delay/ataxia each 1/3 meet the numerical threshold, but direct neurologic injury from this immune defect, independent of separate infections, is not established.

basis: External-ear and mandibular-condyle malformations define the syndrome. Glossoptosis and narrow mouth do not establish lasting oral dysfunction; feeding difficulties occur in 1/12.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: glossoptosis 3/5 and narrow mouth 7/14 describe anatomy without established functional injury; feeding difficulties occur in only 1/12.

basis: Inherited aldosterone excess with defining hypertension; elevated aldosterone, elevated aldosterone:renin ratio and hypertension each occur in 5/5.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: early-onset hypertension is a defining clinical manifestation of familial hyperaldosteronism IV and occurs in 5/5.

basis: Lymphoid-cell malignancy originating in the rectum; blood-cell lineage supports haematologic, and lymphoma requires infectious_immune.

decisions.haematologic: primary: lymphoma is a malignancy of lymphoid blood cells even when its anatomical origin is extranodal; blood or marrow infiltration is not required.

basis: Renal hypoplasia/azotemia, alopecia and severe delay 4/4; contractures/genu valgum 4/4. Hepatic steatosis 3/4 and eyelid hypoplasia 4/4 omitted at cap.

decisions.neurologic: primary: severe global developmental delay and microcephaly occur in 4/4, with hydrocephalus in 3/3; these constitute a major defining disease component.

basis: Scrotal skin lesion defined by ectatic superficial dermal capillaries and overlying hyperkeratosis; both skin and capillaries are primary sites.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: the lesion consists of abnormal dilated dermal capillaries; capillaries are explicitly included in the cardiovascular axis.

basis: Microcephaly and severe limb reduction define the syndrome. Pulmonary hypoplasia is reported, but neither a frequency of at least 30% nor diagnostic-criterion status is established.

decisions.pulmonary: none: pulmonary hypoplasia is reported without frequency; the supplied evidence does not establish occurrence in at least 30% or its status as a major diagnostic criterion.
